主要内容: Tucson Electric Power Company (TEP) completed a formal appraisal procedure with three appraisers to determine the fair market value purchase price of Springerville Unit 1, as per lease agreements. The lease agreements state that the determined purchase price will be final and binding. TEP filed a petition in the United States District Court for the District of Arizona to confirm an appraisal of $159 million for lease interests. The petition names owner participants and trustees as respondents. TEP argues the appraisal was conducted properly and seeks judicial confirmation as an arbitration award. Owner participants oppose the petition, claiming the appraisal failed to meet required standards and that TEP has not exercised its purchase option. They request the court dismiss the case, arguing no controversy exists. TEP intends to pursue legal remedies to confirm the appraisal results.
